changes: Sign in with Meta now also mints the FRL (Meta-account) profile token — the token the Meta Horizon app uses — from your signed-in Meta session the way the app does (native SSO → `xfr_create_profile_token`), and hands it to the site with the other two. Refresh tokens fetches a fresh one.

Fetching it opens one brief background tab on meta.com that closes itself — the login step only works from a real meta.com page. You must be signed in to meta.com in this browser (separate from the Oculus sign-in). Adds the "scripting" permission.
